description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three Text-to-SQL models—(zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot)—across three evaluation metrics: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The vertical y-axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 40 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The horizontal x-axis lists the three metrics, each with three grouped bars corresponding to the models. The light blue bar represents the baseline (zero-shot) model, the dark blue bar represents TA-SQL (zero-shot), and the light green bar represents DIN-SQL (few-shot). For Recall, scores are 63.58, 71.90, and 72.29 respectively; for Precision, 88.89, 91.24, and 92.31; and for F1 Score, 75.34, 80.40, and 81.08. DIN-SQL consistently achieves the highest scores across all three metrics, followed by TA-SQL, with the baseline model performing the lowest. The chart visually emphasizes DIN-SQL’s superior performance, particularly in Precision, where it reaches 92.31, the highest value in the chart. All bars are vertically oriented and grouped by metric, with numerical values labeled atop each bar for precise comparison.
